notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Kydele.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Kydele.
Repeat.
